title: 乡村与自然
visual: specific seasonal agriculture, layered depth, tactile materials, insects, wind, water, and changing sunlight
performance: ordinary purposeful activity and observation; let place and time carry the narrative
camera: mix wide environment, medium activity, tactile inserts, close observation, and transitions in light or weather
audio: native cicadas, birds, wind, water, distant work, footsteps, and restrained pastoral score
avoid: empty postcard shots, excessive camera drift, voice-over replacing visible action, artificial sentimental poses
